title: Nationwide FAA Ground Stop Lifted, but Lingering Issues May Still Impact Major Meetings
summary: The ground stop lasted for approximately four hours, and sorting through the disruption will take time. How airlines can handle those challenges will decide whether this weekend is an inconvenience or a business loss for some organizers.

title: Add One More Question to Your Site Selection: What Do the Locals Think?
summary: Research links local happiness to a destination’s appeal, yet local sentiment rarely makes it into meeting planners’ site-selection criteria. Montréal, which has led North America in international association meetings for 10 years running, offers a case study.

title: India and Africa Are the Event Industry’s Next Growth Markets. Can Venues Keep Up?
summary: India's exhibition market is projected to grow nearly four times as fast as the global average through 2030, while Africa is gaining momentum. But venue shortages and infrastructure gaps could constrain expansion in both markets.

title: Terramar Bucks the Trend and Goes Independent. Will Other DMCs Follow?
summary: Many DMCs are independently owned but fewer and fewer operate independently of a network. It’s that distinction that Terramar will use to differentiate itself.

title: Three Keynote Invitations in 81 Minutes: Inside the Predatory Conference Playbook
summary: Questionable conference invitations can be difficult to distinguish from legitimate speaking opportunities. For event organizers, the consequences extend beyond misleading solicitations to undermining trust in legitimate conferences.

title: Is AI Reading Your Proposal Before the Client Does?
summary: Creative Group’s rebuild around data and design shows where agencies are heading, and what AI-first clients will be expecting from them.

title: RainFocus Gives Claude Access to Live Event Data — and the Power to Change It
summary: RainFocus is moving AI beyond analyzing event data to modifying registrations, schedules, and other operational records. But human approval isn’t automatic, leaving event organizers responsible for deciding how much control to give AI.

title: 10 Safety Tips for Women Planners Traveling Solo
summary: Planners sometimes become so focused on keeping their attendees safe that they forget to protect themselves when they travel alone.

title: Ohio State Wants More Meetings. It’s Offering More Than Just Space
summary: Plenty of universities rent meeting space. Ohio State is making its campus easier to book while offering something hotels can’t: access to faculty expertise, research facilities, and academic experiences.

title: New Research: Trade Shows Are Delivering Efficiency, but Education Isn’t Pulling Its Weight
summary: Both buyers and sellers view trade shows as a cost-effective way to meet with the most people — but fewer than one in 10 rank education as the main reason to attend.
